in_hindi.name: जगेश्वर
in_hindi.meaning: पूज्य दुःखहरान (pooja duhkharan) - remover of sorrow ईश्वर (ishvara) - lord

in_marathi.name: Jageshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Jungle
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jageshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jage means 'conqueror' and Ishwar means 'god'. So, Jageshwar is the 'God who conquers'. This name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as the lord of the jungle or the destroyer of evil.

This name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as the lord of the jungle or the destroyer of evil.
